answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 45162 Country: ZM Title: Dream Question: I had a dream 6-8 months ago wherein I saw that I was guided by a man through the stairs of a building and once we reached the terrace I saw minarets of mosques in different colours and when I looked at my right hand side I saw the green dome of the Prophet’s mosque. What does this dream interpret? Answer ID: 45162 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 684/538/H=1434) The dream means that you are more attached to this world and lagging behind in khushu and khuzu in your prayers. You should be punctual in following sunnah and the Shariah in each and every affair. There is a small book “Ummul Amraz” by Hadhrat Maulana Muhammad Zakaria RA, study it thoroughly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
